english: {kerbal}, you're not sending the data?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Control aquí. No nos llega nada. ¿Lo guardas?
english: Control here. Nothing is coming in. Are you keeping it?

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: No. Los guardo. En casa valen más.
english: No. I'm keeping it. It's worth more at home.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Lo guardo para luego.
english: I'm keeping it for later.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Bien pensado.
english: Good thinking.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Vale. Cuídalos bien.
english: OK. Look after it well.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: {kerbal}, nos dicen que tienes datos de {exp}.
english: {kerbal}, we hear you have {exp} data.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Control aquí. ¿Tienes algo para nosotros?
english: Control here. Got anything for us?

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Lo tengo, pero se queda aquí. Paciencia.
english: I have it, but it stays here. Patience.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Sí, pero lo guardo. Tendréis que esperar.
english: Yes, but I'm keeping it. You'll have to wait.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Los científicos odian esperar.
english: The scientists hate waiting.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Esperaremos. Sin prisa.
english: We'll wait. No rush.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, esto parece valioso. Lo guardo.
english: Control, this looks valuable. Keeping it.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Esto vale mucho. No lo mando por radio.
english: This is worth a lot. Not sending it by radio.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Bien. Vale {sci} puntos. Tráelo entero.
english: Good. It's worth {sci} points. Bring it back whole.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Buena idea. En casa vale {sci} puntos.
english: Good idea. At home it's worth {sci} points.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Datos de {body} a bordo. Es un viaje largo hasta casa.
english: Data from {body} aboard. It's a long way home.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Los datos se quedan conmigo. Hay mucho camino.
english: The data stays with me. It's a long way.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No te los olvides en {body}.
english: Don't forget it on {body}.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Que vuelvan contigo. Y tú también.
english: Make sure it comes back with you. And you too.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Guardo la muestra de moco. El bote está bien cerrado.
english: Keeping the goo sample. The canister is shut tight.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Moco guardado. No se escapa.
english: Goo stored. It's not getting out.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Bien. El moco viaja mejor que la radio.
english: Good. Goo travels better than radio.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Perfecto. Por radio el moco pierde mucho.
english: Perfect. Goo loses a lot over the radio.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Cierro la bahía de materiales. Los datos se quedan dentro.
english: Closing the materials bay. The data stays inside.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Materiales guardados. No los mando.
english: Materials stored. Not sending them.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Bien hecho. Así valen mucho más.
english: Well done. They're worth much more that way.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Recibido. Tráelos a casa.
english: Copy. Bring them home.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Muestra de {biome} guardada en la bolsa.
english: Sample from {biome} in the bag.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: La muestra de suelo va en la bolsa.
english: The surface sample goes in the bag.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Bien. Una piedra en la bolsa vale más que una por radio.
english: Good. A rock in the bag is worth more than one over the radio.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Que no se caiga la bolsa.
english: Don't drop the bag.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Informe de paseo guardado en el traje.
english: EVA report stored in the suit.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Tengo el informe en el traje.
english: I have the report in my suit.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Bien. Que no se moje el traje.
english: Good. Keep the suit dry.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Recibido. Al volver a bordo, guárdalo bien.
english: Copy. When you get back aboard, store it well.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Informe de tripulación escrito y guardado.
english: Crew report written and stored.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Informe escrito. Se queda en la carpeta.
english: Report written. It stays in the folder.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Bien. Lo leeremos en casa.
english: Good. We'll read it at home.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Recibido. Que no se manche.
english: Copy. Don't get it dirty.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, guardo todo a bordo: {exp_list}.
english: Control, keeping it all aboard: {exp_list}.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Hice {exp_count} experimentos. Todos guardados.
english: Ran {exp_count} experiments. All stored.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Bien. Una buena carga para traer a casa.
english: Good. A nice load to bring home.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Recibido. Cuida esa carga.
english: Copy. Look after that load.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: La estantería de datos está llena: {exp_list}.
english: The data shelf is full: {exp_list}.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Ya no cabe más en la estantería.
english: The shelf can't take any more.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Tráela entera. Con cuidado.
english: Bring it back whole. Carefully.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Buena carga. No frenes de golpe.
english: Nice load. No sudden braking.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: {kerbal}, vemos {exp_count} experimentos, pero no nos llega nada.
english: {kerbal}, we see {exp_count} experiments, but nothing is coming in.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Control aquí. ¿Te lo guardas todo?
english: Control here. Keeping it all?

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Sí. {exp_list}. Todo vuelve conmigo.
english: Yes. {exp_list}. It all comes back with me.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Sí. Todo vuelve conmigo.
english: Yes. It all comes back with me.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Entendido. Te esperamos.
english: Understood. We'll be waiting.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Vale. Vuelve con todo.
english: OK. Come back with all of it.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Tengo un tesoro de datos a bordo. {exp_list}.
english: I have a treasure of data aboard. {exp_list}.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Tengo un tesoro de datos a bordo.
english: I have a treasure of data aboard.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Pues no lo pierdas. Vale {sci} puntos.
english: Then don't lose it. It's worth {sci} points.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Tráelo a casa, pirata.
english: Bring it home, pirate.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Todo hecho y guardado. Lo mando más tarde, o lo llevo.
english: All done and stored. I'll send it later, or bring it.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Guardo {exp_list}. Ya veremos qué mando.
english: Storing {exp_list}. We'll see what I send.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Tú decides, {kerbal}.
english: Your call, {kerbal}.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Bien. Sin prisa.
english: Good. No rush.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, mando {exp_list} por la antena.
english: Control, sending {exp_list} over the antenna.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: La antena está trabajando. Va todo.
english: The antenna is working. It's all going.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Lo vemos llegar. Bonito.
english: We see it coming in. Nice.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Recibido todo. {sci} puntos.
english: Got it all. {sci} points.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Datos de {exp} enviados, Control.
english: {exp} data sent, Control.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Datos enviados por la antena.
english: Data sent over the antenna.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ya están aquí. Gracias.
english: They're here already. Thanks.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Recibidos. {sci} puntos.
english: Received. {sci} points.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: La antena va despacio, pero va.
english: The antenna is slow, but it's going.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Mandando datos. La barra se mueve.
english: Sending data. The bar is moving.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Paciencia. Llegará.
english: Patience. It will get here.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Lo vemos llegar poco a poco.
english: We see it coming in, bit by bit.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: He terminado {exp}. Datos listos para revisar.
english: I finished {exp}. Data ready for review.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Recibido. El equipo de ciencia revisará los resultados.
english: Copy. The science team will review the results.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Informe desde el agua. El traje flota y la vista se mueve.
english: Report from the water. The suit floats and the view keeps moving.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Recibido. Sigue cerca de la nave y mantén cerrado el casco.
english: Copy. Stay near the ship and keep the helmet shut.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Informe de {here}. Hay olas hasta donde alcanza la vista.
english: Report from {here}. Waves as far as I can see.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Anotado. No hace falta contarlas todas.
english: Logged. You don't have to count them all.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Intento escribir el informe, pero el agua mueve el cuaderno.
english: I'm trying to write the report, but the water keeps moving the notebook.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Primero flota. El papeleo puede esperar.
english: Floating first. Paperwork can wait.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Muestra de agua recogida. El recipiente está cerrado.
english: Water sample collected. The container is sealed.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Perfecto. No la mezcles con el agua de beber.
english: Perfect. Keep it away from the drinking water.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Muestra de {here} guardada. Creo que el recipiente gotea.
english: Sample from {here} stored. I think the container leaks.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Entonces usa otro. Queremos estudiar el agua, no tu mochila.
english: Then use another one. We want to study the water, not your backpack.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Muestra lista. Agua y unas burbujas muy científicas.
english: Sample ready. Water and some very scientific bubbles.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Etiqueta el recipiente. Las burbujas también cuentan.
english: Label the container. The bubbles count too.
